gloss: chunky sweet bean paste; coarse red bean paste

definitions.gloss: chunky sweet bean paste; coarse red bean paste
definitions.explanation: Sweet red bean paste (あんこ) in which the azuki beans are only partially mashed, leaving visible bean pieces for a chunky texture.

examples.japanese: {粒|つぶ}あんの{大福|だいふく}が{好|す}きだ。
examples.english: I like daifuku with chunky bean paste.

examples.japanese: {粒|つぶ}あんとこしあん、どちらが{好|す}きですか。
examples.english: Which do you prefer, chunky or smooth bean paste?

examples.japanese: この{和菓子屋|わがしや}の{粒|つぶ}あんは{小豆|あずき}の{食感|しょっかん}がしっかり{残|のこ}っている。
examples.english: The chunky bean paste at this Japanese sweets shop retains a firm azuki bean texture.

notes:
Composed of {粒|つぶ} (grain, particle) + あん (sweet bean paste). One of two main types of sweet red bean paste, distinguished by its chunky texture with visible bean pieces.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {粒|つぶ}あんの{大福|だいふく}: daifuku with chunky bean paste
- {粒|つぶ}あんパン: bread filled with chunky bean paste
- {粒|つぶ}あんのおはぎ: ohagi with chunky bean paste
- {自家製|じかせい}{粒|つぶ}あん: homemade chunky bean paste

SIMILAR WORDS:
- こしあん: smooth bean paste — strained to remove skins, completely smooth texture
- {粒|つぶ}あん vs こしあん is one of the classic preference debates in Japan, similar to the debate over crunchy vs smooth peanut butter

ALTERNATE WRITING:
Also written as {粒餡|つぶあん}. Sometimes called {小倉|おぐら}あん ({小倉餡|おぐらあん}).

RELATED WORDS:
- あんこ: sweet bean paste (general term)
- {小豆|あずき}: azuki beans (the base ingredient)
- こしあん: smooth/strained bean paste
